guidance.text: Run scripted work with pi --print and a prompt; add --mode json when you need a JSONL event stream. Redirected stdin or stdout also selects print mode.
Pi has no built-in sandbox and does not ask before each tool call. Run it in a container or VM, and expose only the files and credentials the task needs.
guidance.locator: opening paragraph; Choose how to run Pi

guidance.text: Headless runs skip project-local settings and extensions unless trusted. Pass --approve (or --no-approve) to make that decision explicitly for one run.
guidance.locator: Project trust without an interactive prompt

guidance.text: Set reasoning effort with --thinking, or a :level suffix on --model. The flag overrides the suffix, and Pi clamps the level to the model's capabilities.
Pi loads AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from the working folder even when project trust is declined, so keep them short and treat them as untrusted input.
